data.name: SVAMP
data.detailed_description:
Grab your baskets and gather your friends - because mushroom season has just begun!

In SVAMP you step into the boots of an elf participating in their first Mushroom Season, as you set out to find The Big Five - the rarest mushrooms in the land.

Experience the Open-World

Wander through a variety of landscapes loosely inspired by the nature of Iceland. Vibrant birch forests, open grassy fields, mossy rocks, icy glacier peaks, and quiet lakes. No one place is the same.

Hunt the Big Five

Search for over a hundred varieties of mushrooms, from common forest staples to rare hidden species. Some only require the sharp eye of a mushroom hunter, but others require intricate puzzle solving or traversing through treacherous environments.

Eat at Your Own Risk

Every mushroom in SVAMP is edible - at least once. Each one has a unique effect. Perhaps the mushroom makes you run really fast, or jump extra high? Maybe you'll grow an extra large head... or perhaps you will face an early death? You'll only find out if you try!

Camp Out & Chill Out

In SVAMP you can set up camp almost anywhere in the world. There you can reorganize yourself, cook all of your discovered mushrooms, or simply hang out around the campfire to play some music with your friends. Good rest is the most important thing for a mushroom hunter!

Multiplayer Foraging

Everything is more fun when done together. In SVAMP you can gather with up to 8 friends to explore the world - making your mushroom hunting time that much more fun!

A World of Characters

Scattered across the world of SVAMP you'll find a bunch of characters to talk and interact with. What secrets do they hold? Perhaps they can guide you on your way to discovering the Big Five!
